target_surface: Internal warehouse scanner deployed as a static Vercel frontend plus Node.js Functions
request_summary: Remove the CoWork dependency and make the hands-free scanner a standalone deployable application.
included_pages: official bol Retailer API authentication, conventions, v10, orders and shipments documentation
official Vercel Functions and environment-variable documentation
official Turso TypeScript client, batch-transaction, and server environment documentation
Bankhoes BI Dashboard AGENTS.md, engineering/Context.md, integrations/Context.md, lib/db.ts, package.json, and sanitized Turso database identity
excluded_pages: Live bol Seller Dashboard or retailer data
Any Vercel team, project, deployment, or environment configuration

active_rules: Preserve the proven FIFO fail-closed scanner loop
No external account access without a matching project authority rule
Never expose bol/database credentials, password hashes, or session secrets to the browser
Operational state and auth lockout must be shared and durable in isolated Turso ampere_* tables

A materially changed plan requires a sealed independent review
